purpose: Design of the /forge:start-requirements orchestrator skill that creates requirements documents in interactive, reverse-engineering, and from-figma modes via self-contained workflow files.
summary: Dispatcher SKILL.md responsibilities: mode selection, concept check, delegation to workflows
File layout of the skill and its three workflow documents
Flowchart of the three modes and their phases
Common rule for decisions just before writing: new-project check, additive vs differential type, feature, output directory, file name
Interactive mode: draft-driven, on-demand context gathering, doc_status draft, type re-judgment
Reverse-engineering mode: source analysis with parallel agent context collection
From-figma mode: Figma MCP, two-layer design tokens, SCR/CMP/FNC, static assets
Design principles: focus on What, per-mode context gathering, workflow self-containment
Completion steps: review, ToC update, commit confirmation
tasks: Modifying the start-requirements skill or its workflows
Deciding feature, output path, and file name for requirements
Judging additive versus differential development type
Adding a new requirements creation mode
